hudLayout.topThird: Top 16% is an empty black band in the capture (missing header — the normal chapter book / coin / XP / follower counters / quest scroll header belongs there). At 16-19% a khaki tab bar spans full width: wide selected tab left with a farm-cottage icon and white bold 'LOCAL FARM', a small red badge '6' at its top-right corner; then two khaki location tabs (orange boulder/rock icon, green oak-tree icon) and two dark grey locked tabs with black silhouette icons. Below, from 19% to 44%, a top-down painted terrain map (ochre plains, maroon mountain ridges, dark conifer clusters, pale river) backs a row of three hero slots.
hudLayout.middleThird: Hero slot row (22-41%): three tall portrait card slots on teal 9-slice bases. Slot 1: purple-lit storm dwarf wizard with braided white beard, lightning crackling from his hand, crimson 'X' remove button top-right, dark power badge bottom-centre showing '13' over a lightning swirl. Slot 2: red-lit grinning golden-haired elf warrior in armour, crimson 'X' top-right, dark badge '21' with a slash mark. Slot 3: empty grey slot with a large white plus, on a plum base. From 45% down, three dungeon level rows on a dark navy field, each row: left a square henchman portrait tile in a purple frame with a lime/khaki level label, red 'UPGRADE AVAILABLE' text and an item multiplier; centre a teal level bar with the level name, beneath it a wide amber hire button with cost row; right two drop-icon tiles with count numbers and red count badges, and a teal side button.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Third dungeon row ends at ~75%. A full-width amber button 'Click to explore' (text faded) sits at 77-85%. Below, centred grey-white text over two lines and a thin dark progress bar. The bottom ~5% is a black empty band (missing footer).

uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice buttons and panels in flat saturated jewel tones (amber hire buttons, teal level bars and side buttons, purple portrait frames, crimson X buttons, khaki tabs) with darker warm front lips; crisp clean edges, uniform spacing, white bold sans labels with dark drop shadow. Item icons are glossy painted with dark self-coloured rims inside square olive tiles. Feels like programmatic engine chrome.
